prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” broker for everyone — the right broker depends on what kind of coverage you need (individual/family, ACA marketplace, Medicare, small‑business/group), whether you want in‑person help, and whether you prefer an independent broker who can shop many carriers or a captive agent who only represents one.

How to find a great health insurance broker in Kansas City
- Clarify your need: individual/family, ACA (Marketplace), Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, or employer group benefits.
- Prefer independent brokers: they represent multiple carriers and can compare more options.
- Verify licensing: check the Missouri Department of Commerce & Insurance and the Kansas Insurance Department (queries by agent name or NPN).
- Read reviews: Google, Yelp, Better Business Bureau, and local Facebook community groups.
- Check experience and specialties: make sure they work with the plan type you need (Medicare agents should be certified to market Medicare; ACA assisters/navigators can help with Marketplace enrollment).
- Ask these questions when you interview a broker:
  - Which carriers do you work with? Are you independent?
  - How are you compensated — commission, fees, or both?
  - Do you help with claims and renewals after enrollment?
  - Can you provide local references or client testimonials?
  - Are you licensed in Missouri and/or Kansas (as relevant)?
  - Do you help with subsidies, appeals, or special enrollment periods?
- Consider navigators for Marketplace help: federally funded assisters can help enroll you in Marketplace plans at no cost.

Where I can help next
If you tell me:
- the ZIP code for where you live (Kansas City spans MO and KS),
- what type of plan you need (individual/ACA, Medicare, employer plan), and
- whether you prefer in‑person or virtual help,
I can look up and recommend several well‑reviewed local brokers/agencies and provide contact info and notes on their specialties.
